## What you will build

Build a reproducible package that parses, validates, and summarizes a partly damaged CSV log.

Follow the units in order and complete each unit challenge. Keep examples and
debugging notes that help explain your choices. This overview is orientation,
not a scored activity.
<!-- fcpython-chapter-lab: end -->

## Unit sequence

1. [Solving Problems with Algorithms](units/problem-solving-algorithms/index.qmd) — 4 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/problem-solving-algorithms/challenge.qmd).
2. [Errors, Exceptions, and Debugging](units/errors-exceptions-debugging/index.qmd) — 4 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/errors-exceptions-debugging/challenge.qmd).
3. [Files, Paths, and External Data](units/files-paths-external-data/index.qmd) — 5 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/files-paths-external-data/challenge.qmd).
4. [Modules, Environments, and Python Projects](units/modules-environments-projects/index.qmd) — 6 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/modules-environments-projects/challenge.qmd).

## Prepare and pace your work

Complete the preceding milestone in the [course sequence](../../index.qmd),
or review its outcomes if you already have that experience. Use each unit's
active-time estimate and pause at lesson boundaries. Plan another 2–4 hours for
the milestone challenge, including rerunning checks and explaining your result.

Use Colab for notebook exercises and the workspace introduced in the units for
local environment, packaging, and command-line tasks.

## Connect the units

Finish with [Recover the Observatory Log](challenge.qmd). Combine the milestone skills and check a
changed condition. The challenge provides a contract, expected results, a hint,
and self-review guidance.

Community learning is ungraded. Completion controls record your own progress
only in this browser on this device; they do not issue a verified credential.
